bullets: Chennai drone technology firm Zuppa Geo Navigation Technologies plans to raise up to $10 million in equity funding to expand its technology development centre and engineering team.
The AI, IT and Digital Services office should monitor Zuppa's fundraising progress and support local drone manufacturing and tech expansion initiatives in Chennai.

stories.title: Zuppa eyes $10 million funding as it looks to scale domestic and international business
